hints.title: Task Frequency Grouping
hints.text: Tasks of the same difficulty must be completed in batches of 2 or 3.

hints.title: Single Task Impossibility
hints.text: If any task difficulty appears exactly once, it is impossible to complete and the answer is -1.

hints.title: Greedy Batching Formula
hints.text: For a frequency c >= 2, the minimum number of rounds is ceil(c / 3), which equals (c + 2) // 3.

hints.title: Frequency Counter Implementation

complexity.notes: Frequency table construction and single pass summation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating rounds with recursion or search TLEs when task counts reach 10^5.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate deduces the closed-form (c + 2) // 3 minimum rounds.
